decisions: Ordinary logout requires visible identityFacts account and one operation-local transient handle for both revocation phases; no later shared SDK logout.
Failed logout operation IDs require authoritative re-entry and cannot recapture a replacement account/session.
Back to sign in and Start again are inert application reset, with no provider logout or factor deletion.
Direct bounded account verification maps only exact 401/403 session_not_found/session_expired to signed out; malformed/network/400/429/5xx stay unavailable.
Provider logout requires a 2xx confirmation; dead-current-token errors do not prove global revocation.
SDK persistence remains provider-owned; no cache-erasure guarantee, raw storage mutation, private SDK lock, durable marker or global auth rewrite.
authority: Reviewed source/PR CI continuation only; no main merge, hosted changes, credentials, installs or local container startup.
